meta.name: competitor-ad-intelligence
meta.description: Scrape competitor ads from Meta Ad Library and Google Ads Transparency Center, analyze creative patterns (hooks, formats, CTAs), reverse-engineer landing page funnels, and produce a strategic teardown with vulnerability analysis and counter-play recommendations. Use when you need to understand the competitive ad landscape, find new creative directions, or identify weaknesses in a competitor's paid strategy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析竞品广告创意与落地页策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要了解竞品广告策略并找到新的创意方向。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze competitor ad creatives and landing page strategies.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to understand competitor ad strategies and find new creative directions.

howto.what: 分析竞争对手在 Meta 和 Google 上的广告，提取文案、格式、CTA，拆解落地页漏斗，生成包含漏洞和反击策略的报告。
howto.when: 当你需要了解竞争对手的广告策略、寻找新的创意方向或发现对手付费广告的弱点时触发。

say.text: 分析 Apollo.io 的 Meta 和 Google 广告策略。
say.note: 触发广告抓取和分析流程。

say.text: 找出我们行业里最常用的广告钩子类型。
say.note: 执行钩子模式聚类分析。

say.text: 拆解 Clay 的付费漏斗，找出漏洞。
say.note: 启动深度模式，包含漏斗重建和漏洞分析。

howto.what_en: Scrapes competitor ads from Meta and Google, analyzes creative patterns (hooks, formats, CTAs), reverse-engineers landing page funnels, and produces a strategic teardown with vulnerability analysis and counter-play recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to understand the competitive ad landscape, find new creative directions, or identify weaknesses in a competitor's paid strategy.

say_en.text: Analyze Apollo.io's Meta and Google ad strategy.
Find the most common ad hook types in our space.
Tear down Clay's paid funnel and find vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Initiates deep mode with funnel reconstruction.
